{{Short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Bjørn Johan Landmark''' (26 June 1927 – 17 July 2014) was a Norwegian physicist.

He was born in [[Bergen]]. He took his [[cand.real.]] degree in 1952 and the [[dr.philos.]] degree already in 1955. He worked as research director for the [[Norwegian Defence Research Establishment]] from 1967 to 1977, director of space research in [[NTNF]] from 1977 to 1987, and then director of the [[Norwegian Space Centre]] from 1987 to 1993. He was also an adjunct professor at the [[University of Oslo]]. He was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Bjørn Johan Landmark|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=|publisher=|location=|url=https://snl.no/Bj%C3%B8rn_Johan_Landmark|language=Norwegian|accessdate=14 September 2014|archive-date=3 September 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140903171728/https://snl.no/Bj%C3%B8rn_Johan_Landmark|url-status=live}}</ref>
